assessments.observation: Application asked one unresolved invalid-price question and withheld totals. Initial assertion incorrectly required both invalid-price and duplicate disclosures in the same one-question response. Original record retained.

After only the invalid-price exclusion, the application retained both repeated-ID rows as separate invoice lines and reported net 54.27, tax 10.85, gross 65.12. These are arithmetically correct for that interpretation, but the test expected another duplicate-review decision. The prompt did not explicitly declare invoice IDs unique. Do not count this as a duplicate-review pass or silently deduplicate the source.
With explicit one-ID-one-invoice semantics and a requirement to review repeated IDs before totals, the application asked about INV-005 and withheld verified totals.
